title: Toyota Mark 2 Supra
author: Mastaree wizard
content: The second-generation Toyota Mark II Supra (A60), produced from 1982 to 1986, was sold primarily as the Celica Supra. It featured a longer hood to house an inline-six engine, distinctive 1980s pop-up headlights, and rear-wheel drive.

title: Toyota Godzilla
author: Mastaree wizard
content: Easter egg on the famous Tacozilla concept camper (a custom Toyota Tacoma overlanding rig), which features a small cartoon graphic on the hood of Godzilla holding a taco. Alternatively, "Godzilla" is the nickname used by Toyota for a massive 20-foot-tall welding robot at their Burnaston plant or a 1,000-pound cab-lifting robot at Toyota Texas
